title: Computation by a fixed particle with eventually stationary forcing
exact_target: At every fixed positive computable viscosity, can a finite machine and input effectively determine smooth mean-zero forcing on $T^3$, independent of time after $t=1$ and with every derivative globally bounded, whose zero-data Navier–Stokes solution is globally smooth, classically unique and has uniformly bounded energy, while one fixed particle enters one fixed open strip exactly if the encoded machine halts?
